records.author: OKHP3
records.body:
## Summary
- handle gzip-compressed upstream responses in the technology refresh script
- preserve the existing standard-library-only implementation

## Root cause
The Python.org endpoint returned a gzip payload despite the identity request header; direct UTF-8 decoding failed on byte 0x8b.

## Validation
- fetched and decoded the Python.org page locally
- git diff --check

The pre-existing generated inventory update remains uncommitted in the local mirror.

review_comments.author: Copilot
review_comments.body: `Content-Encoding` can legally include multiple codings (e.g. "gzip, br") or vary in casing. Checking for equality with "gzip" may miss compressed responses and reintroduce the UTF-8 decode failure. Also, if decompression fails, the exception lacks URL/header context for debugging.

reviews.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]
reviews.body: ## Pull request overview This PR updates the `ops/check_technology_updates.py` technology refresh utility to correctly handle upstream HTTP responses that arrive gzip-compressed, while keeping the script standard-library-only. **Changes:** - Detect gzip-compressed payloads (via `Content-Encoding` header or gzip magic bytes) before UTF-8 decoding. - Decompress gzip payloads and then decode to text for downstream parsing. --- 💡 Add a `code-review` agent skill or configure MCP servers for context-aware, tailored reviews. Learn more in the docs.
